SUPERSEDED BY THE PROMOTION, in every clause. Original text: '7/7 MATCH, objisolate clean, reloc-destinations clean -- including the ROM's deleting destructor D0 reproduced from a single real ~daMcFlag_c() with dActor_c's inline operator delete on the TU-local shadow base. include/daMcFlag_c.h guard-suppressed (its daMcFlag_c is the flat C view without a destructor); math/Matrix.h included first so Behavior's .t spelling of Matrix4x3 wins; the legacy hand-mangled D0 file's body dropped (mwccarm ICEs on a hand-mangled D0 plus a real destructor in one TU).' None of that describes the file any more. The TU no longer carries TU-local shadow classes: src/game/actors/d_a_mc_flag.cpp is compiled against the real include/daMcFlag_c.h, which is no longer guard-suppressed, and math/Matrix.h is not included at all. The hand-mangled D0 body is gone too -- both destructor variants are now real C++ output from the single inline `virtual ~daMcFlag_c() {}` in the header. The 7/7 MATCH figure is the only clause that survives, and it was re-earned by the promoted file, not carried over.

PROMOTION (read this first). The shadow TU verified 7/7 text-only and did emit this class's vtable, but it did so against TU-local shadow classes rather than the real header, and that is what the promotion had to replace. Which destructor variants mwccarm emits, and in what order, turns on two conditions, and an intermediate rewrite that met only one of them -- a file that declared `extern int _ZTV10daMcFlag_c[]` and so emitted no vtable of its own -- odr-used neither destructor and came back MISSING _ZN10daMcFlag_cD1Ev/_ZN10daMcFlag_cD0Ev at 5/7. The committed file is the class's KEY-FUNCTION TU: InitResources is the first declared virtual, and include/daMcFlag_c.h declares the destructor INLINE, which together make mwccarm emit D1 then D0 -- the cartridge's order, D1 at 0x02112078 and D0 at 0x021120a8, with no D2 -- plus this class's _ZTV/_ZTI/_ZTS. That is what the nine compiler_only_output rows below are. VPTR SPELLING: the source writes `&_ZTV10daMcFlag_c[2]`, but mwccarm folds the 8-byte address-point bias at compile time -- all three R_ARM_ABS32 relocations naming the symbol carry addend 0 over a zero content word -- so after production isolation empties the emitted section and turns the symbol into an import (SHN_UNDEF in build/src/actors/d_a_mc_flag.o), each store resolves to symbols.txt's 0x02113ba0, which IS the address point: 0x02113b98 = 0 offset-to-top, 0x02113b9c = _ZTI10daMcFlag_c, 0x02113ba0 = slot 0 (InitResources, 0x02112190). WALL 6az ON THE CALLER SIDE: dExtAnmModel_c::SetAnim takes Fix12<int> by value (include/dExtAnmModel_c.h line 88) and a by-value class argument makes mwccarm home the constant and reload it with `ldr r3,[pc]; ldm r3,{r3}` where retail has a plain `mov r3,#0x1000` -- 0x68 bytes against the cartridge's 0x60. Brace-initialised local, const local, a returning inline helper, a gccext compound literal and a Fix12 with a real raw-bits constructor all produce the same reload; only the mangled free-function spelling with a SCALAR speed parameter matches, the same workaround the landed src/game/actors/d_a_obj_bc_switch.cpp carries. It costs InitResources the CONVERTED tier's no-mangled-refs criterion, but that member did not hold the tier before the promotion either, so the ratchet moved 2584 -> 2584, +0/-0 and no backslide exception was needed. The licensed range is .text 0x02112078-0x02112228.
